body.text:
"Scrubbed your grout raw and it still looks gray, stained, or moldy? Here's the real fix, and it's not another cleaner:

If that's you, you're not doing anything wrong. You're just fighting a problem that was never going to be solved with a brush, a bottle, or an extra hour on a Saturday. 

We've talked to hundreds of homeowners across Knoxville who've tried everything on the shelf, from bleach and baking soda pastes to rented steam cleaners and every ""miracle"" grout pen on Amazon, and the story is almost always the same: it looks better for a week, and then it's right back to gray, black, or pink again. That's not a reflection of how hard you scrubbed. It's a reflection of what grout actually is.

Standard grout is porous. It soaks up water, soap, oil, and mildew like a sponge. Add Knoxville's hard, mineral heavy water and East Tennessee's humid summers, and you've basically got the perfect storm for staining and mold. No cleaner fixes that. It's a material problem, not a cleaning problem, and that's exactly why the DIY stuff never sticks for more than a couple weeks.

At Elite Grout Knoxville, we restore your grout with a proven 3-step process:

1️⃣ Repair: We fix failing, cracked, or crumbling grout with a durable epoxy grout built to last.
2️⃣Deep Clean: We strip years of buildup, mold, and stains from every single grout line.
3️⃣Seal: We apply our epoxy color sealer, color-matched to your tile, creating a barrier that's waterproof, stain-resistant, and mold & mildew-resistant.

The result: grout that looks brand new and stays that way for years — not months. Every job is backed by our 5-year transferable warranty, so you're covered even if you sell your home.

📍 We serve homeowners across Knoxville and the surrounding metro, out to a 45 mile radius: Farragut, Bearden, West Knoxville, Sequoyah Hills, Fountain City, Powell, Karns, Halls, South Knoxville, plus surrounding communities like Maryville, Oak Ridge, Lenoir City, and Sevierville. We know this region's water and climate because we work in it every single day.

Here's what happens when you reach out: we schedule a free estimate, come take a real look at your tile and grout, and give you an honest answer on whether restoration makes sense for your space. No high pressure pitch, no upsells you didn't ask for, just a clear plan and a clear price before any work ever starts. 🙌

👉 Click below for your free estimate, or give us a call. We'll take a look, tell you honestly what your grout actually needs, and get you back to a bathroom, kitchen, or floor you're actually proud of again.
"
